page.layout: One printed page (left) with a block of italic text at the top; below it, a centred hyphenated heading word "SAN-" between two rules; no margin notes. The right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: dum hominum præsentem vitam facta & dicta ejus re-
censenda suscepit; unde quemadmodum divo Joanne
pro usitata sua celsitate pertractat) paulo dimissior,
sic etiam eo Christianis compluribus utilior est; ut
pote qui ea Christi opera, consiliaque & præcepta
præcipuo[?] quodam consilio referre studuit, in quibus homi-
nem, quem gerebat, ad nostra imitationis temperavit

page.notes: The first line of the italic block is a fragment from the previous page. Long s is transcribed as s; "ufitata" printed with long s is read as "usitata". "præcipno" is printed; read as præcipuo[?]. The rules and the "SAN-" word stand mid-page; "SAN-" is a fragment and may be the start of a word continued elsewhere. The right-hand text is from the neighbouring page and is omitted. No page number or running head is printed.
